DASH PAXT: KEYS APART

Who this is for
Owners of Dash masternodes and evonodes.

What partners agree to
1. Each masternode has a voting key that is not its owner key.
2. The owner key stays offline. It is used only to change the registration.
3. Rewards are paid to an address that is not the collateral address.
4. Partners share what they learn. A failure or a fix seen on one's own nodes is written up for the others, with no one named.

How it is shown
Articles 1 and 3 are public. Anyone can read them from the masternode list (Dash Core: masternodelist json).
Article 2 cannot be read from the chain. A partner's word stands for it.

How partners decide
A change to this text is a new document with a new hash, and partners join it with a new signed line.
A poll among partners uses an id of the form dash-keys-apart/<name>.

When it holds
It comes into force when keys carrying 111 votes have joined by the closing date.
Below that it lapses and asks nothing of anyone.

Leaving
A partner can leave at any time by signing the leave line.

What this text is
It describes a practice. It is not advice for any one setup and it promises no outcome.
